sentences.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
First Appeal No. - 154 of 2021
Court No. - 35
Hon'Ble Sandeep Jain, J.
1.

The instant appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 has been filed by the land
owners aggrieved against the impugned award and decree dated 15.11.1988 passed by Shri O.P.
Garg, District Judge, Ghaziabad in L.A.R. No. 199/85 (Risal (dead) through LRs and others vs. State
of U.P.)

whereby the compensation, for the acquired land situated in village Chhalera Khadar,
Pargana and Tehsil Dadri, District Gautam Budh Nagar vide notification under Section 4 (1) of the
Land Acquisition Act, 1894 dated 14.03.1980, at the rate of Rs. 19500/- per bigha along with other
statutory benefits under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 has been awarded.

2. Learned counsel for the appellants submitted that for the similarly acquired land situated in village Chhalera Khadar, Pargana and Tehsil Dadri, District Gautam Budh Nagar which was acquired vide notification dated 14.03.1980, this Court in First Appeal No. 757 of 2012 (Deo Karan and others vs. State of U.P. and another) along with two other connected first appeals vide order dated 16.12.2016 referred the matter to the larger Bench, which was heard and decided by the Division Bench of this Court vide order dated 03.11.2017, whereby compensation at the rate of Rs.
297/- per square yard along with other statutory benefits admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 was awarded to the land owners, which was further challenged by the NOIDA by filing Civil Appeal No. 4879 of 2018 (NOIDA vs. Deo Karan and others) before the Apex Court which has been partly allowed vide order dated 01.05.2018 whereby the compensation awarded by the Division Bench of this Court at the rate of Rs. 297/- per square yard has been reduced to Rs. 125/- per square yard along with other statutory benefits as may be admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel further submitted that in view of above decided case of the Apex Court, the appellants are entitled to get enhanced compensation at the rate of Rs. 125/- per square yard for their similarly acquired land situated in village Chhalera Khadar, Pargana and Tehsil Dadri, District Gautam Budh Nagar.

4. Per contra, learned counsel for the NOIDA very fairly conceded that the land acquired in the Likhi Ram And 12 Others vs State Of U.P. on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/136997447/
1 village Chhalera Khadar, Pargana and Tehsil Dadri, District Gautam Budh Nagar vide notification dated 14.03.1980 has attained finalty and the land owners have been awarded compensation at the rate of Rs. 125/- per square yard, along with other statutory benefits as may be admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
5.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel has further submitted that this Court may not grant interest on the enhanced compensation to the land owners for the period during which the appeal remained defective for want of court fees.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

7. It is apparent that the instant appeal relates to land situated in village Chhalera Khadar, Pargana and Tehsil Dadri, District Gautam Budh Nagar which was acquired vide notification under Section 4 (1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 dated 14.03.1980.
The possession of the acquired land was taken on 12.05.1980.

The award of the Collector was made on 31.07.1982, whereby compensation at the rate of Rs. 17000/- per bigha was awarded to the land owners along with other statutory benefits as may be admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

8. The land owners had challenged the award of the Collector by filing reference which has been allowed by the impugned award and decree dated 15.11.1988, whereby compensation was further enhanced to Rs. 19500/- per bigha along with other statutory benefits as may be admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
9.

It is also apparent from the record that for similarly situated acquired land in village Chhalera Khadar, Pargana and Tehsil Dadri, District Gautam Budh Nagar, which was acquired by notification under Section 4 (1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 dated 14.03.1980, the Division Bench of this Court in First Appeal No. 757 of 2012 (Deo Karan and others vs. State of U.P. and another) along with four other connected first appeals has awarded compensation at the rate of Rs. 297/- per square yard along with all other statutory benefits as may be admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 which was challenged by the NOIDA by filing Civil Appeal No. 4879 of 2018, New Okhla Industrial Development Authority (NOIDA) vs. Deo Karan and others, which has been partly allowed by the Apex Court vide order dated 01.05.2018, whereby compensation awarded by the Division Bench of this Court at the rate of Rs. 297/- per square yard has been reduced to Rs. 125/-
per square yard.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Apex Court has also awarded the other statutory benefits, as may be admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

10. In view of above, the appellants are also entitled to get compensation for their land situated in village Chhalera Khadar, Pargana and Tehsil Dadri, District Gautam Budh Nagar acquired vide notification under Section 4 (1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 dated 14.03.1980 at the rate of Rs.
125/- per square yard along with the other statutory benefits, as may be admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
11.
Accordingly, the instant appeal is allowed.

The appellants are entitled to get enhanced compensation at the rate of Rs. 125/- per square yard along with 30% solatium and enhanced Likhi Ram And 12 Others vs State Of U.P. on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/136997447/
2 interest under Section 28 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
12.

entities.text: Likhi Ram And 12 Others vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The appellants are not entitled to get additional compensation at the rate of 12% per annum,
because the possession of the land was taken on 12.05.1980 as held by the Apex Court in the case of Union of India vs. Giani, (2011) 11 SCC 480.
13.

entities.text: Union of India vs. Giani, (2011) 11 SCC 480
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The instant appeal was filed on 14.03.1989, which was dismissed for deficiency of court fees on 26.10.1989, which was restored on 18.03.2021 and the deficiency of court fees was made good on 30.01.2019.

As such, the appellants are not entitled to get any interest on the enhanced compensation awarded by this Court for the period 14.03.1989 till 30.01.2019.
14.
However, in the facts and circumstances of the case, the parties shall bear their own costs.
15. Office is directed to prepare the decree, accordingly.
